<style="highlight">Ravion's Special Drink: Nocturnal Whisper</style>
The purified <style="highlight">darkspring water</style> captures the elegance of the night, while the <style="highlight">crystal salt</style> not only adds a refreshing touch but also shimmers like twinkling stars.
Now, pour in the <style="highlight">secret brew</style> and blend it with finesse...

Voila, it's done! Go ahead and admire its mesmerizing beauty in the dark.
Give the glass a gentle swirl, and the shimmer within will captivate you long before the first sip ever touches your lips.
The mellow sweetness and refreshing touch will leave you wanting more.
But don't let the pleasant flavor fool you—it will knock you out before you even realize it!
document:3:192:0.source_cn:
<style="highlight">沙利叶的绝妙特调·星与夜的低语</style>
净化后的<style="highlight">暗泉水</style>犹如夜晚般深沉幽雅。而<style="highlight">幻晶盐粉</style>的加入，不仅让它的口感愈发清淡，又让它仿佛闪烁着点点璀璨的星光。
最终，倒入<style="highlight">秘制基酒</style>，以高超的手法进行调制——
看吧，它诞生了！它的外形就已然足够美丽，尤其适合在暗处欣赏。
轻轻摇晃酒杯，那摇曳的绚丽星彩几乎能在入口前就令人为之沉醉。
而那柔和甜蜜的风味与清淡的口感，也完全不会造成任何饮用障碍，不由自主地就会让人一杯接着一杯。
但务必要注意！它可是一杯货真价实的高度烈性酒，甚至能点燃火苗！

say:11:1421141001:1.text: Mmm, this is so good! I never disappoint myself.
say:11:1421141001:1.source_cn: 嗯，味道不错，不愧是我，手艺总是这么出色。

say:12:1421141002:1.text: Imperator, can you tell us about Captain Indris now...?
say:12:1421141002:1.source_cn: 所以，沙利叶大人你该告诉我们了吧，因度厄大人——

narration:14:1421141003:0.text: Otivia halts abruptly when Indris appears in the distance. Ravion doesn't hesitate—he shoves the whole group into a secluded corner.
narration:14:1421141003:0.source_cn: 欧蒂薇话音未落，街道尽头突然出现了因度厄的身影。沙利叶...

say:16:1421141004:1.text: Wait for me here and don't make any noise! I'm about to show you something jaw-dropping!
say:16:1421141004:1.source_cn: 你们藏在这里别出声，等着我，给你们看一个绝对独家，绝对...

say:17:1421141005:1.text: Wait a minute, you... I mean, Imperator, don't tell me you're going to mess with Indris again!
say:17:1421141005:1.source_cn: 喂，你……您该不会又要捉弄因度厄了吧！沙利叶大人！

say:18:1421141006:1.text: Why make me sound like a jerk? Everyone has to pay the price for their wrongs, right?
say:18:1421141006:1.source_cn: 那怎么是捉弄呢，那是我们真挚的友情以及与之相应的反向友...

say:19:1421141007:1.text: ... I've got a bad feeling about this.
